evidence: M-O s.v. card ranks: ace, from Vives 1540
terms.comment: Vives’s name for the card: in Lewis & Short monas is the unit, the number one (post-classical: Macr., Tert.).
Traupman gives it for the ace, but in Isidore (Orig. 18.65), the only author Lewis & Short cites, it is the two on a die, a deuce.

sources: Lewis & Short: monas · Lewis & Short: binio
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 51, checked against the searchable text of the book on 11 November 2026.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. card ranks: ace.
